translation_notes: The single literal `PREFIX agimage: <...>` line moves to a file-scope @prefix, inherited into the island's prologue -- not recopied inside s{ }. The query text itself is kept exactly as written, mixed style included: `agimage:Platform` stays a prefixed name, `<https://w3id.org/agri-image/platformName>` stays a full bracketed IRI, since SS2 forbids rewriting query text beyond the construction substitution.

results is s{ }'s own lazy Query result on the translated side and an rdflib Result on the original side; both are re-iterable (rdflib's Result materialises its rows on first pass), so `for row in results: ...` followed by `return results` behaves identically on both sides and needed no extra materialisation code in the island, unlike the sibling region in this stratum whose result was consumed only once.

fixture.ttl gives two Platform solutions (Tractor A, Drone B) plus neighbourhood that must not match: a Platform with no platformName, and a non-Platform resource that does have a platformName. The zero-solution case is exercised as a second driver call against a fresh empty Graph() rather than in the fixture itself, since this region is a function with its own entry point (unlike the bare-statement sibling region, where a second call was not available).
